interventions.what: text screen and GOAL.EXE data-segment memory (the pool index array at [DS:A927], the base table DS:6D18, the player array at [DS:A91B], the name arrays at [DS:9B6C] and [DS:9B70]) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
a savestate is written at each read, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147), game folder recreated from the verified release copy, GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads the savestate whose sha256 is given (E006's main-screen state of a new game made at DOS time 10:00 on 10/04/2026, release E006, e006-1000-r0001.sav; screen digest 18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it; DOS clock of this session not set (the restore brings the state's own BIOS ticks, F004)
